# U115: Start 2027 only prepares it: on 21 Dec 2026 the read-back counts every goal once; afterwards everyone is still in 2026 and Cycles offers Undo, which puts 2026 back; started again, 2027 opens for everyone on 4 Jan 2027. A workspace whose only year is 2027 says when it starts and has nothing due

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `CARRY-GOALS`
- **Budget:** at most 8 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `budget` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 1622

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- _Note:_ The example copied into a workspace of Amara's own, so it keeps 2026 when the clock moves (as U10 does).
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Monday 21 December 2026.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Start 2027” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” link.
- **Check:** “Everyone stays in 2026 until Sun 3 Jan 2027” is shown.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the read-back's counts ({counts.join(', ')}) don't add up to the {live} goals.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “read-back”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** “2027 is ready” is shown.
- _Note:_ Nobody moves: Home is still 2026.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 21 December 2026.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if starting 2027 moved everyone into it early.
- _Note:_ Undo puts 2026 back as it was.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Tuesday 22 December 2026.
- **Step.** Press the “Undo” button in the “2027 is ready” section.
- **Check:** “2027 was undone” is shown.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if Undo did not put 2026 back.
- _Note:_ Started again, then 4 January 2027: everyone is in 2027.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles/next` in the demo on Wednesday 23 December 2026.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** “2027 is ready” is shown.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 4 January 2027.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if on 4 Jan 2027 the frame said “{a value worked out in the journey}”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) as the code checks it.
- _Note:_ What came with the goals (CY4): watches and open asks follow; no stage is due after week 52; no number plan starts late. A module's records that follow (metric links) are the module's own journey's to check (U152; fix item F6).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if carried goals came without their watches or asks, or with a plan past week 52 ({came}, {planned}).
- _Note:_ A workspace whose only year is 2027, on 11 Nov 2026: it says when it starts, and nothing is due.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`parity`) it fails if a year not begun: “{a value worked out in the journey}”.
- Close this browser.
